summary: Move the tests that start a real daemon from st3-client and st3-feed into a test-only package, st3-e2e

replay.detail: Tests and manifests only. No runtime, store or replay behaviour changes.

schema.detail: No database schema, schema version or migration changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and fleet coordination are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: No binary, HTTP API or generated client changes. Two items of the st3-feed library become public (Window::ALL and link_lost) so the moved tests can reach them.
